Intro: Stand ready for my arrival, lowly chef. I have come to take you under my wing, and become the shepherd to the lost soul within you.
You could make a fine apostle to the blessed Eve, the one who had conquered the demon of Conquest itself!
Curious, are you not? Of what trials I had undergone to become the dashing mystic I am today?
Be my faithful servant, and I might be willing to divulge. Oh, and do be kind to my younger brother. He's a sensitive soul, always following me around.
Success: The type of work I expect from my future apostle.
Fail: Are you attempting to test me as well? Why have you served me such despicable food?
Reject: You dare to reject this opportunity? You are even more of a fool than my little brother.
